payload.note: Exact localized-slab corrector checkpoint: for every L divisible by four, insert the V2 exponent cell in four time rows and repeat it over a spatial period and two inert axes. Rowwise exponent cancellation puts the family exactly in the mean-zero E_p-perpendicular slice. Independent L=8 and L=12 enumeration retains two nonzero seam-current rows and proves A_L=(837/128)L^3 and E_dir,L=(290423/1024)L^3. The lowest-mode corrector obeys |Khat_0(p_L)|>=3L^3/16 for multiples of four L>=300, so its ratios to N omega_p A_L, N omega_p E_dir,L, and N omega_p(A_L+E_dir,L) diverge at least linearly. Thus deterministic pointwise action/Dirichlet proofs are obstructed even with an extra N loss. This is not a Gibbs counterexample: slab probability/correlation, the statistical corrector estimate, current susceptibility, score, H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
